|strategy=By Ian MacDonald

When using the [[Executor]] I find it is most useful when, instead of pumping it up with pilots, I use it as a troop ship in my Ground/Space deck. I put one Imp. Helmsman so that when he is on it alone you can draw battle destiny for attrition if some rebels become a problem.For saftey's sake give it an [[Ion Cannon]] and a [[Turbolaser Battery]].To back it up also deploy a couple of TIEs.
|combos=* [[Executor]] + [[Imperial Helmsman]] Draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

* [[Captain Piett]]
